canonical_question: Why was a specific alloy (Al10Nb15Ta5Ti30Zr40) chosen as a comparison for future work, and what is its predicted mechanism for increased ductility?

question_variants.question: Why was a specific alloy (Al10Nb15Ta5Ti30Zr40) chosen as a comparison for future work, and what is its predicted mechanism for increased ductility?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The text identifies the alloy Al10Nb15Ta5Ti30Zr40 as promising 'increased room temperature ductility' which would lead to 'crack-free processing'. It does not detail the specific mechanism for this increased ductility.

answers.answer: The paper states that 'More recently developed refractory metal high entropy alloys like Al 10 Nb 15 Ta 5 Ti 30 Zr 40 [ [49] ] promise an increased room temperature ductility and hence crack-free processing'. The mechanism for the ductility increase is not elaborated upon in the text.
answers.mechanism: not specified, linked to crack-free processing
answers.boundary_limitation: Mechanism of ductility increase not explained.
evidence_spans: A PBF-LB/M machine of the type AconityMINI (Aconity GmbH, Herzogenrath, Germany) was used for manufacturing cubic samples with an edge length of 6 mm on molybdenum substrate plates obtained from Plansee SE (Reutte, Austria).
The machine is equipped with a redPower QUBE single mode fiber laser from SPI Lasers Ltd. (Southamton, UK) featuring an operating wavelength of 1080 nm and a maximum power of 1 kW.
The scanner optics used is an AxialScan-30 from Raylase GmbH (Wessling, Germany).
